purpose: Cross-market discovery screen for new Korean and U.S. equity candidates under the Investment Harness screener policy.
credential_policy: No user-supplied API credential or secret is persisted in this repository. The runtime could not safely inject pasted KIS/OpenDART/Twelve Data secrets into arbitrary HTTP calls. Screening therefore uses public/connected market-data evidence only and is explicitly not represented as direct secret-authenticated API output.
authority_note: Additive discovery artifact only. SCREEN_IN means deeper underwriting is warranted, not FULL_ANALYSIS, buy authorization or portfolio inclusion. No company latest pointer is changed.
methodology: False-negative-tolerant first pass: structural revenue/profit or industry change, customer value, early moat trajectory, plausible FCF/share scaling, financing/dilution survivability and valuation sanity.
High or low P/E alone is never a reject reason.
Second pass prioritizes direction of margins/ROIC/FCF, balance-sheet resilience, concentration, dilution and whether current price already consumes a Bull case.

Korea discovery evidence includes a KOSPI200/KOSDAQ200 400-stock public screener that states it uses KIS quote snapshots and DART financials, supplemented by issuer/market evidence. U.S. evidence uses public structured financial-statistic pages after the connected Financial Datasets screener returned insufficient credits.
